description: This file contains utility functions, event handlers, and state management for the notes application, including note creation, linking to external resources, and updating related data stores.

methods.name: toCamelCase
methods.description: Converts a string to Camel Case with the first letter capitalized.

methods.name: openMonographsWebpage
methods.description: Opens the Notesnook help webpage about publishing notes with monographs.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Opens the note editor, focusing on the editor page or setting the editing state.

methods.name: setOnFirstSave
methods.description: Sets a callback to handle actions after the first save of a note, based on provided data type.

methods.name: onNoteCreated
methods.description: Handles post-creation actions for notes, linking them to notebooks, tags, or colors, and updating related stores.
